title: Hodge Theory of $p$-adic analytic varieties: a survey
summary: Hodge Theory of $p$-adic analytic varieties was initiated by Tate in his 1967 paper on $p$-divisible groups, where he conjectured the existence of a Hodge-like decomposition for the $p$-adic étale cohomology of proper analytic varieties. Tate's conjecture was refined by Fontaine who gave the theory its definite shape. A lot of work has been done for algebraic varieties and a number of proofs of Fontaine's conjectures have been obtained between years 1985 and 2011.
